summary: gen-architecture now takes an exposed Service's in-house service from the container it routes to: an exposures: entry names that container outright, and a port-routed front door with no in-house service of its own (or no route) falls back to the pod's single one. On a scratch KubeCoderDeploy with kube-coder-tunnel-reclaim mapped, kubecoder.home references svc:kubecoder-controller-api, mints nothing and prints no gap. Comparing the old and new generator on the 26 in-house deploy repos, five other repos lose a duplicate minted service, as intended, and nothing else changes. Code is ArgoCDTools 91b21aa; the aac-tools gate is green.
